dialogues.jp: 「暇つぶしにと、神社に来てみた訳だが」
dialogues.en: "(I always seems to come to the shrine when I'm bored.)"
dialogues.text: "(I always seems to come to the shrine when I'm bored.)"

dialogues.jp: 環と巫女について話すのも、悪くない。
dialogues.en: It's kinda enjoyable, talking to Tamaki aboutMiko.
dialogues.text: It's kinda enjoyable, talking to Tamaki aboutMiko.

dialogues.jp: （あれ……？　今日は居ない……のか？）
dialogues.en: "(Eh....? She's not around today?)"
dialogues.text: "(Eh....? She's not around today?)"

dialogues.jp:
神社の中を歩き回ったものの、環を見つけるこ
とはできなかった。
dialogues.en: I walked around the shrine, but couldn't find her anywhere.
dialogues.text: I walked around the shrine, but couldn't find her anywhere.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、しょうがない、か」
dialogues.en: "Oh well."
dialogues.text: "Oh well."

dialogues.jp:
巫女装束の環を見ようと思ったけど……こうい
う日もある。
dialogues.en:
I thought I'd see Tamaki in her Miko dress today... looks
like it's not meant to be.
dialogues.text:
I thought I'd see Tamaki in her Miko dress today... looks
like it's not meant to be.

dialogues.jp:
無駄足だったなと重い足を引きずって帰ろうと
向きを変えた時。
dialogues.en: Thinking I'd wasted my time, I started heading back, when...
dialogues.text: Thinking I'd wasted my time, I started heading back, when...

dialogues.jp: ざあああああ……。
dialogues.en: *whoooooosh...*
dialogues.text: *whoooooosh...*

dialogues.jp: 風が流れた。
dialogues.en: A wind blew past suddenly.
dialogues.text: A wind blew past suddenly.

dialogues.jp: 風は俺を取り巻き、足を止まらせる。
dialogues.en: It surrounded me entirely, keeping me from walking.
dialogues.text: It surrounded me entirely, keeping me from walking.

dialogues.jp: ざあああああ……。
dialogues.en: *whoooooosh...*
dialogues.text: *whoooooosh...*

dialogues.jp:
耳元で鳴る風は、まるで俺に話しかけているよ
うで──。
dialogues.en:
The roar of the wind almost made it seem like it was trying
to talk to me...
dialogues.text:
The roar of the wind almost made it seem like it was trying
to talk to me...

dialogues.jp: ザワザワ……。
dialogues.en: *flutter...*
dialogues.text: *flutter...*

dialogues.jp: 木がなびき、話に加わってくる。
dialogues.en: The trees started swaying, joining in on the conversation.
dialogues.text: The trees started swaying, joining in on the conversation.

dialogues.jp:
俺は上を見て、そこに一本の大きな｛まき／槙｝の木を認
めた。
dialogues.en: I looked up, at a large tree in front of me.
dialogues.text: I looked up, at a large tree in front of me.

dialogues.jp: （でかい木だな……）
dialogues.en: "(What a huge tree...)"
dialogues.text: "(What a huge tree...)"

dialogues.jp: 樹齢何百年、ってところか。
dialogues.en: It looks like it's survived for hundreds of years.
dialogues.text: It looks like it's survived for hundreds of years.

dialogues.jp: 御神木なのか、周りに柵がある。
dialogues.en: Fences surrounded it, protecting it from outside influence.
dialogues.text: Fences surrounded it, protecting it from outside influence.

dialogues.en: "(What is this...?)"
dialogues.text: "(What is this...?)"

dialogues.jp: 俺の足が動き出す。
dialogues.en: My legs began to move by themselves.
dialogues.text: My legs began to move by themselves.

dialogues.jp: 風と木の会話にでも混ざろうっていうのか。
dialogues.en:
To get further mixed into the conversation between the wind
and the trees.
dialogues.text:
To get further mixed into the conversation between the wind
and the trees.

dialogues.jp: まるで導かれるように、その木に歩み寄る俺。
dialogues.en:
As if guided somehow, my legs led me to the base of the
tree.
dialogues.text:
As if guided somehow, my legs led me to the base of the
tree.

dialogues.jp:
柵の手前まで来て、槙の木を見上げた時、俺の
中の何かが動いた。
dialogues.en:
Placing my hands on the fence, and looking up to this tree,
something inside me stirred.
dialogues.text:
Placing my hands on the fence, and looking up to this tree,
something inside me stirred.

dialogues.en: ".....Please listen to me..."
dialogues.text: ".....Please listen to me..."

dialogues.jp: なんだ、今の？
dialogues.en: What the?
dialogues.text: What the?

dialogues.jp: 風の声……じゃないよな。
dialogues.en: That wasn't... just the wind.
dialogues.text: That wasn't... just the wind.

dialogues.jp: 遠い昔、どこかで聞いたような……。
dialogues.en: It sounded like a voice I've heard long ago...
dialogues.text: It sounded like a voice I've heard long ago...

dialogues.jp: それに、この木。
dialogues.en: And, this tree.
dialogues.text: And, this tree.

dialogues.jp: 俺はこの木を知っているような気がする。
dialogues.en: I've seen this tree before, somewhere, somehow.
dialogues.text: I've seen this tree before, somewhere, somehow.

dialogues.jp: すごく懐かしいような……。
dialogues.en: It feels so nostaglic...
dialogues.text: It feels so nostaglic...

dialogues.jp: 何だろう。
dialogues.en: What's happening?
dialogues.text: What's happening?

dialogues.jp: 一生懸命、記憶の糸を手繰り寄せる。
dialogues.en:
I tried my best to recall every thread of my memory for such
an instance...
dialogues.text:
I tried my best to recall every thread of my memory for such
an instance...

dialogues.jp: 「ねえ…………なってくれない？」
dialogues.en: "Hey..... you can't remember?"
dialogues.text: "Hey..... you can't remember?"

dialogues.jp:
聞こえる声の正体を確かめたいのに、その糸は
弱くて、掴んだ途端千切れてしまって。
dialogues.en:
The voice rang through my ears again, disturbing my
concentration.
dialogues.text:
The voice rang through my ears again, disturbing my
concentration.

dialogues.jp: 思い出せない。
dialogues.en: I simply can't remember.
dialogues.text: I simply can't remember.

dialogues.jp: （なんなんだ？　これ……？）
dialogues.en: "(The hell is this...?)"
dialogues.text: "(The hell is this...?)"

dialogues.jp: ありがちなデ・ジャヴなのかも知れない。
dialogues.en: Maybe it's just a case of deja vu...
dialogues.text: Maybe it's just a case of deja vu...

dialogues.jp: そう言い切ってしまうのは簡単なのに。
dialogues.en: But I can't just declare that so easily either.
dialogues.text: But I can't just declare that so easily either.

dialogues.jp: 何でだろう？
dialogues.en: Just what is going on?
dialogues.text: Just what is going on?

dialogues.jp: 俺はそう言い切りたくなかった。
dialogues.en: I didn't know anything for sure.
dialogues.text: I didn't know anything for sure.

dialogues.jp: 俺が固まっていると──。
dialogues.en: Perhaps, only that I exist as I am now--
dialogues.text: Perhaps, only that I exist as I am now--

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 柔らかい、声。
dialogues.en: A soft, tender voice.
dialogues.text: A soft, tender voice.

dialogues.jp: どこかで聞いたことのある、声。
dialogues.en: A voice I've heard many times before.
dialogues.text: A voice I've heard many times before.

dialogues.jp:
声の正体が知りたくて……でも、確かめるのが
何となく怖くて。
dialogues.en:
A voice I wanted to know more of... yet scared to find out
more, at the same time.
dialogues.text:
A voice I wanted to know more of... yet scared to find out
more, at the same time.

dialogues.jp: ゆっくりと振り返ると。
dialogues.en: I turned around slowly.
dialogues.text: I turned around slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様、いらしてたんですね」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, did you just arrive?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, did you just arrive?"

dialogues.jp: そこには、笑顔を浮かべた環が立っていた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki stood there, with her usual gentle smile.
dialogues.text: Tamaki stood there, with her usual gentle smile.

dialogues.jp: 環の、声……か。
dialogues.en: The voice of Tamaki... indeed.
dialogues.text: The voice of Tamaki... indeed.

dialogues.jp: ……なら、聞いたことがあって当たり前だよな。
dialogues.en: ...Of course I've heard it many times before.
dialogues.text: ...Of course I've heard it many times before.

dialogues.jp: 教室で、あるいは桜並木で。
dialogues.en: At class, on the way to school...
dialogues.text: At class, on the way to school...

dialogues.jp: 会えば挨拶をして、その時に聞くんだから。
dialogues.en: When we say hello... audible at all those times.
dialogues.text: When we say hello... audible at all those times.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……どうかしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Is something the matter?"
dialogues.text: "...Is something the matter?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は環から視線を離して、木を見つめた。
dialogues.en: I let my gaze trail off from Tamaki, and lock onto the tree.
dialogues.text: I let my gaze trail off from Tamaki, and lock onto the tree.

dialogues.jp:
「この木……何だか見覚えがあるような気がす
　るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "This tree... made me remember something from long ago."
dialogues.text: "This tree... made me remember something from long ago."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「見覚え……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Remember... you say?"
dialogues.text: "Remember... you say?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。でも……よく思い出せなくて」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... but I can't recall exactly what it is."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... but I can't recall exactly what it is."

dialogues.jp:
思い出すための記憶の糸は、今も掴んだ先から
千切れてしまう。
dialogues.en:
The vague picture I had in my mind as I searched the threads
of my memories, was now in pieces.
dialogues.text:
The vague picture I had in my mind as I searched the threads
of my memories, was now in pieces.

dialogues.jp:
もどかしい。自分の記憶だからこそ、余計｛いらだ／苛立｝
ちが募る。
dialogues.en:
It's irritating, considering how much useless stuff that's
stuck in there...
dialogues.text:
It's irritating, considering how much useless stuff that's
stuck in there...

dialogues.jp: 「……止めだ、止め」
dialogues.en: "...Stop it, you, stop it.."
dialogues.text: "...Stop it, you, stop it.."

dialogues.jp: 俺は髪をかき回して、振り返った。
dialogues.en:
I shook my head back and forth vigourously, letting my hair
flop around.
dialogues.text:
I shook my head back and forth vigourously, letting my hair
flop around.

dialogues.jp: 「俺に考え込むのは似合わない」
dialogues.en: "Brooding doesn't become me."
dialogues.text: "Brooding doesn't become me."

dialogues.jp:
俺がそう言うと、環が何とも言えない複雑な表
情をした。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki had a complex expression on her face as she heard my
monologue.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki had a complex expression on her face as she heard my
monologue.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「というか、そもそも、こんなに考え込むのは
　かったるい」
dialogues.en:
"And pondering over something so deeply like this is
troublesome anyway."
dialogues.text:
"And pondering over something so deeply like this is
troublesome anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「かったるい……。朝倉様、らしいですね」
dialogues.en: "Troublesome... how very like Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Troublesome... how very like Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 環が微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: Her giggles lifted the mood.
dialogues.text: Her giggles lifted the mood.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、俺のことはさておき、だ。どこ行って
　たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, enough about me. Where were you?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, enough about me. Where were you?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「買い物です」
dialogues.en: "I was shopping."
dialogues.text: "I was shopping."

dialogues.jp: 見れば、確かに環の手には、買い物袋があった。
dialogues.en: Indeed, she was carrying a shopping bag with her.
dialogues.text: Indeed, she was carrying a shopping bag with her.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「食事の用意をしようと思って……あっ、そう
　です！」
dialogues.en:
"I was buying ingredients to prepare for dinner... ah,
that's right!"
dialogues.text:
"I was buying ingredients to prepare for dinner... ah,
that's right!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「よろしかったら、一緒にお食事を召し上がっ
　て行きませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"If you have nothing else to do, would you like to have a
meal with me?"
dialogues.text:
"If you have nothing else to do, would you like to have a
meal with me?"

dialogues.jp: お食事……。
dialogues.en: A meal...
dialogues.text: A meal...

dialogues.jp: なんと｛こわく／蠱惑｝的で、魅力的な響きなんだ。
dialogues.en: What an alluring and charming word.
dialogues.text: What an alluring and charming word.

dialogues.jp:
しかも、神社でご飯を食べるというのも、なか
なか無い経験だ。
dialogues.en: Furthermore, I've not tasted food from a shrine before.
dialogues.text: Furthermore, I've not tasted food from a shrine before.

dialogues.jp: だけど。
dialogues.en: However,
dialogues.text: However,

dialogues.jp:
音夢一人で飯を食わせるのも、何となく可愛そ
うに思える。
dialogues.en:
Thinking of Nemu eating by herself, made me feel lonely for
her.
dialogues.text:
Thinking of Nemu eating by herself, made me feel lonely for
her.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、今日はやめておくよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, not today."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, not today."

dialogues.jp: 「音夢のことが気になるし……」
dialogues.en: "Nemu's probably expecting me..."
dialogues.text: "Nemu's probably expecting me..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですよね。やっぱり」
dialogues.en: "A, ahh, of course."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh, of course."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり？」
dialogues.en: "Of course?"
dialogues.text: "Of course?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「い、いえ。何でもありません」
dialogues.en: "O, oh, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "O, oh, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp: いつもより強い口調で言い切る環。
dialogues.en: Her tone was stronger than usual.
dialogues.text: Her tone was stronger than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「また、次の機会にしましょう」
dialogues.en: "Well then, until we meet again."
dialogues.text: "Well then, until we meet again."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「悪いな。せっかく誘ってもらったのに」
dialogues.en: "Sorry again, maybe next time."
dialogues.text: "Sorry again, maybe next time."

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと……というか、かなりもったいない気
はするが。
dialogues.en: Although... I don't feel like I'm worthy of it.
dialogues.text: Although... I don't feel like I'm worthy of it.

dialogues.jp:
俺は環に別れを告げ、夕日で赤く染まる神社を
後にした。
dialogues.en:
I seperated from Tamaki, and left the shrine under the red
of the evening.
dialogues.text:
I seperated from Tamaki, and left the shrine under the red
of the evening.

dialogues.jp: ◆大きな槙の木◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Large Evergreen Tree?◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Large Evergreen Tree?◆

dialogues.jp: 暇つぶしに神社へ行くと、環はいなかった。
dialogues.en:
With nothing to do, I went to the shrine, but Tamaki wasn't
there.
dialogues.text:
With nothing to do, I went to the shrine, but Tamaki wasn't
there.

dialogues.jp:
ぶらぶらと境内を歩き回ると、一本の槙の木を
見つける。
dialogues.en:
Wandering aimlessly around the shrine grounds, I happened
upon a large evergreen tree.
dialogues.text:
Wandering aimlessly around the shrine grounds, I happened
upon a large evergreen tree.

dialogues.jp:
何だか、とても懐かしい気がするのだが、思い
出せなかった。
dialogues.en:
It gave me a nostalgic feeling, but I couldn't place exactly
what it was.
dialogues.text:
It gave me a nostalgic feeling, but I couldn't place exactly
what it was.
